key_rules.ipcbuf_create_internal: sync metadata is created at K; key_increment is 0x00010000; then semkey_connect=K+0x10000; each reader semkey_data increments by 0x10000; each data-buffer shmkey increments by 0x10000
key_rules.implication: a ring footprint is a deterministic family of SysV keys only after the exact K, nbufs and nreaders are known; no +1-only inference is used for the data/semaphore family

metadata_visibility.creator_proof: cpid/cuid and timestamps are available, but /proc/sysvipc alone does not identify the creating command/argv; task ownership requires matching live/dead PID identity plus recorded task ledger/config, not IPCKEY alone

destroy_semantics.dada_db: -d selects destroy mode; source reconnects data K and header K+1, then ipcbuf_destroy each
destroy_semantics.ipcbuf_destroy: IPC_RMID is issued for connect/data semaphores and every buffer/sync shm segment; detach is attempted before shm IPC_RMID
destroy_semantics.persistence: -w/persist waits for signal before destroy; no signal was sent in this Phase0
destroy_semantics.safe_cleanup_boundary: only exact task-owned K plus derived family, with verified owner/cpid/geometry and retained ledger, is eligible; unknown or key-only matches are not eligible

create_flags_and_partial_failure.default_flags: IPCUTIL_DEFAULT_CREATE_FLAGS = IPCUTIL_PERM | IPC_CREAT | IPC_EXCL, with IPCUTIL_PERM=0666
create_flags_and_partial_failure.existing_key_behavior: creation is exclusive; an existing sync/semaphore/shm key causes the corresponding create call to fail rather than attach
create_flags_and_partial_failure.partial_data_ring: ipcbuf_create_work_internal creates sync metadata, semaphores and data buffers incrementally; ipcbuf_get records failures and returns -1, but the observed function has no rollback call before returning
create_flags_and_partial_failure.data_then_header: dada_db returns immediately if data-ring creation fails; if data creation succeeds but header creation fails, the source returns immediately without calling ipcbuf_destroy on the already-created data ring
create_flags_and_partial_failure.race_safety: preflight emptiness is not an exclusivity proof: a concurrent creator can win after inspection, and a failed partial create may leave task-unknown IPC objects; cleanup must use creator/ledger/geometry identity and never broad key deletion
